preview_command: Reconstruct the retained workspace with support/replay_snapshot.py, then run python3 -m http.server 4403 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory app. Use ?theme=light&lang=en, ?theme=dark&lang=zh, and &fail=once for the declared local fault fixture.
capture_conditions: Playwright 1.57.0, Chrome headless shell 143.0.7499.4, recorded Noto CJK font, DPR 1; 1440x900, 1280x600, 390x844, English/Chinese and light/dark. Actual unchanged 750 ms local save fixture. Sampled still frames, not natural-time playback.
